question: Should editor exports and DOM contracts use neutral names across the Plate facade and its runtime, and which public nouns should disappear instead of being renamed?
method: best-api-review/history-v2; bounded component follow-up; first-principles and hard-cut comparison
trigger: User chose data-editor-authored and asked harsh honest feedback on keeping Plite/Plate component names.
requirements: Use neutral public names with the package import selecting the distribution.
Preserve model identity, mounted view lifetime, native selection, plugin presentation and passive control binding.
Preserve serialized authored metadata when adopting data-editor-authored.
Assessment only; do not implement downstream renames.
evidenceReuse: Rechecked current raw Plite root, Plate integration, passive EditorProvider, real toolbar-overlay consumer and authored HTML codec. The prior record remains matching and is reaffirmed; this follow-up selects EditorRoot from its earlier candidate names and accepts data-editor-authored as the target marker.
summary: Pursue EditorRoot as the public root component in each React entrypoint, retain the independently useful passive EditorProvider, and adopt data-editor-authored through coordinated codecs.
alternatives: Keep Plate/Plite: readable branding but duplicates package identity and conflicts with the explicit neutral public vocabulary.
Rename both public roots EditorRoot: preferred; names the composition role and preserves the same implementation/lifetimes. Plate keeps its runtime root composition private.
Rename root Editor: conflates parent composition, model type and visible copied editor; a less precise common call site.

Rename or merge root into EditorProvider: the real toolbar-overlay consumer needs passive binding without another mounted view; a mode flag obscures two jobs. Existing names alone are not the reason to retain the distinction.
Delete runtime root or Plate integration: source proves view/selection and plugin/scope jobs; deleting them for spelling alone would change behavior. Cut the extra public vocabulary instead.
Add aliases or wrappers: no extra public dialect, component or runtime machinery is justified.
proofLimits: Source inspection and prior matching review evidence only; no implementation, package tests, browser proof or authored format migration was run. Root naming changes no runtime machinery. Exact other export names are not covered. Global review inventory remains independently stale.
